main.description: Record that the authenticated user does not want to see a particular paper suggestion. The paper is filtered out of future suggestions.

source.description: External catalogue the suggestion came from, for example openalex or crossref

externalId.description: Identifier of the suggested work within that catalogue

success.description: Whether the suggestion was recorded as dismissed

errors.name: AuthenticationRequired
errors.description: Authentication is required to dismiss a suggestion

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: The source or external identifier was missing or malformed
